lifecycle.scope: Fresh isolated HOME, shared task tmp transpiler cache, source launcher, pipe-backed terminal. Input ACK is an executed extension command, not merely session_start or fully completed startup. No live provider or sandbox work. Probe changes import order. Settling delay 100ms excluded.

native.scope: Operator-observed real PTY smoke with automatic TTY/exit/raw assertions; not a latency distribution or resize/selection acceptance.
Operator-observed real PTY smoke with automatic TTY/exit/raw assertions; not a latency distribution or resize/selection acceptance.

interpretation.providerCacheHitRate: Unmeasured; no provider requests were sent.
interpretation.activeSandboxShutdown: Unmeasured; no tool/VM work was requested.
interpretation.cwd: Empty task-owned child directories within checkout; parent repository discovery remains possible. Not a claim about arbitrary external workspaces.
interpretation.markdown: Identity theme/no syntax highlighting, corrected single-space plain control, timing samples exclude the first 10 updates.
interpretation.prefix: Each batch contains 100 complete builds/permutations, not one provider request. Five processes, ten measured batches each. Zero drift does not imply a cloud hit.
interpretation.modelCold: refreshOnCreate=false, child process per sample. Parent heap is not child heap. No actual user configuration or auth.
interpretation.noise: Per-process p95 noise bands over 10% are provisional and require task-specific stabilization before approving a candidate; structural gates remain authoritative.

corrections.snapshot: Initial task-only snapshot read item.manifest.name after buildPlan intentionally released manifest; corrected to item.name, then captured all outputs. No product code loaded in that failure.
corrections.priorMedian: Historical audit used an upper-middle convention in its temporary boundaries helper. This run uses nearest-rank and retains raw samples.
corrections.priorNative: Initial native exploration verified child TMP but did not verify parent TMP; final two runs set child environment before launching the parent and assert both. Earlier exploration is excluded from final validation counts.

reproducibility.notes: Restore task harnesses at .task-tmp/<unique-task-id> (repository depth 2). Supply isolated TMP/TEMP/TMPDIR before execution, including native harness parent. Run performance commands serially. CLI source files are versioned under scripts/bench. Native smoke uses a real PTY: submit /pf-lifecycle-ready then /quit. Lifecycle benchmark needs no manual input.

resources.cleanup: Evidence retained before first push; exact cleanup and final branch/review/CI receipt will be recorded in the PR closeout comment.

frameStabilityFollowup.reason: Initial 5k-main per-process p95 band 19.1% exceeded the 10% stabilization gate. Preserve original runs. Increase warmup to 2000 and measured frames to 20000; no production change or deleted samples.
frameStabilityFollowup.comparisonRule: Use this longer-window configuration on both baseline and candidate for 5k-main gates; do not compute speedups against the earlier short window.
